name: Add work notes, comments, or resolve
intent: The everyday mutation path. Keep it boring and strict so the model does not invent state transitions.

mode.description: comment writes a customer-visible comment; work_note writes an internal work note; resolve closes the incident

comment.description: Text to post as a comment or work note

procedure: Load by number. Confirm the user can write.

Mode comment: writes comments (customer visible). Mode work_note: writes work_notes. Mode resolve: requires resolution_code + resolution_notes; sets state to Resolved only if Data Policy allows (no open children, required fields present).
Refuse close from this skill. Close is a separate manager path or a Flow.
Show the exact string that will be posted. On confirm, patch.
Return new state, journal snippet, remaining SLA.
sideEffects: posts a comment or work note on the incident; on resolve sets state, resolved_at, and resolution fields

prompts: Add a work note to INC0012345: we rebooted the server.
Resolve INC0012345, root cause was a stale DNS record.
Comment on INC0012345 that the fix is deployed.
